camera_motion.measurement: Camera3D.GetCameraTransform(), the transform submitted to the renderer

tree_fade.probe_scope: Production shaders on one MultiMesh card with a constant projected area; observes real native fade coverage in Forward+ Metal. This does not substitute for forest appearance review.

failures_and_recovery.failure: Old camera fails the motion probe.
failures_and_recovery.recovery: Corrected camera passes with the same probe.

failures_and_recovery.failure: Initial new lane allocation test used an overprecise width-sum assertion for float-authored lane widths.
failures_and_recovery.recovery: Bound matches source precision; zero-allocation requirement unchanged; full 146 C# tests pass.

failures_and_recovery.failure: Initial fade coverage probe expected linear opacity.
failures_and_recovery.recovery: Verified official Forward+ uses smoothstep; updated expected curve. Both production shaders and both polarities pass.

failures_and_recovery.failure: First implementation Windows M0 could not directly execute a Bash script through Python CreateProcess (WinError 193). A bare bash executable resolved to the WSL stub on the first correction.
failures_and_recovery.recovery: Watchdog callers use the current Bash executable via the absolute BASH variable; local gate rerun; remote recovery shown above.

failures_and_recovery.failure: First implementation asset/export CI included CameraInterpolationProbe.tscn in release PCK.
failures_and_recovery.recovery: All export presets exclude game/Automation; unchanged local PCK inspector passes. Remote recovery shown above.

failures_and_recovery.failure: Final uncapped tree capture has four >20 ms frames.
failures_and_recovery.recovery: No zero-stall claim for this capture. A separate V-Sync mode capture has zero >20 ms frames over 120 seconds.

failures_and_recovery.failure: Disabling cockpit interpolation without composing its displayed mount caused position stepping. GetGlobalTransformInterpolated masked this in the first diagnostic.
failures_and_recovery.recovery: Probe now reads actual GetCameraTransform; displayed-parent composition reduces the measured cockpit oscillation from 2.083344 m to zero at the deliberately low 20 Hz test rate.

failures_and_recovery.failure: Final local full rendered suite missed the first controller camera-toggle press: 27 passed, 1 failed.
failures_and_recovery.recovery: The failed controller scenario passed unchanged on an isolated retry. Earlier full suite had passed all 28. Failure transcript and retry are retained; cause is unproven, and the helper uses a 30 ms press.

limitations: Diagnostic interactive desktop; Apple GPU contention unknown, other applications open.
GPU timestamps unavailable on Metal; no CPU/GPU bottleneck split established.
Short fixture captures do not evaluate the 30-minute memory-growth gate, production route, minimum hardware or Windows reference GPU gate.
PC performance and smoother Mac motion are owner reports; exact PC build was not supplied. Navy and local red art were both measured on the Mac.
Initial live trace report preceded assembly-version verification. Later disk assembly identification and process start/build times established the original session had the August fixes.
Original game temporarily suspended during captures, then resumed; raw counter/trace timing is not a user-marked stutter attribution.
V-Sync requested and reported enabled, but frame intervals come from engine monotonic time, not OS display-present timestamps.
recommendation: Retain Godot/C#. Revisit a bounded native extension only for a measured subsystem that still exceeds its budget; no evidence justifies a whole-game rewrite.

owner_feedback.text: Looks way smoother. One thing I'm seeing is a lot of obvious pop-in from the trees LOD
owner_feedback.scope: Motion improvement only; separate driving enjoyment/30-minute handling approval remains open.
